testcase.name: the tapped cell is re-read from the store by its group, week and block
only a point feature is focused for re-anchoring, and only a sighting sets the focused observation
an entry map's kept track gone from Records is named from the entry's snapshot, with no date and no details
a planned trip shows what its Trip Planner row shows
a feature tap becomes the tapped thing, anchored where it was tapped
an offline region shows its name, radius and size, and says Stale only when stale
a track that is in neither Records nor the snapshots has no bubble
a track shows its title, date, distance and duration
the cell bubble's numbers are the stored cell's, beside its layer name, dates and the reference class
a tap near a block edge finds a cell centred in the next block
an entry map's kept waypoint gone from Records is named from the entry's snapshot, with no details
a waypoint shows its name and MGRS
clamped at the left, top and right edges the card moves and the tip stays on the anchor
a glyph 175 px below the top with a 250 px card gets the card below it, the tail pointing up to the glyph
unclamped, the bubble sits above and to the left of the anchor with the tip on it
a glyph with room above keeps the card above it, unchanged
a track still in Records is the record, with details, even when a snapshot exists too
a find shows its identification, its date and its cover photo, an unnamed one its date as the title, and a record gone from its list nothing
every record layer and both colour fields name a bubble kind, and nothing else does
a focused point is re-found in the lists the map draws, and a record no longer drawn is not
where the card fits neither above nor below the glyph M1's clamp stands, and the tip stays on the anchor
a snapshot track with no name is titled as the entry report titles it
a photo shows itself, its date and what it is attached to
